headline.purpose: Page titles only; compact, calm and high contrast.

data.purpose: IDs, timestamps, model names, tokens and logs only.

shadows.name: overlay-only
shadows.purpose: Menus, overlays, and running-avatar status halos only.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single highest-priority action on a surface.
components.css: .ds-primary { min-height: 36px; padding: 8px 14px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 600 14px/1.2 var(--font-sans); transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.22,1,0.36,1); } .ds-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary), white 9%); } .ds-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Operational Panel
components.description: Flat container for related task or status information.
components.css: .ds-panel { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); } .ds-panel h3 { margin: 0 0 8px; font: 600 14px/1.4 var(--font-sans); } .ds-panel p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 13px/1.5 var(--font-sans); }

components.name: Status Badge
components.description: Text, color and dot communicate state together.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; min-height: 20px; padding: 2px 8px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 12px/1 var(--font-sans); } .ds-status > span { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--status-running); }

narrative.overview: A dark desktop cluster deck pairs with a light native mobile collaboration surface. Agent portraits, service groups, and semantic connection halos make multi-agent work feel human and immediately scannable.
keyCharacteristics: State is expressed with color, icon and text
Desktop density with structural mobile reflow

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Mint marks desktop connection and running state; violet marks mobile selection and mentions. Neither decorates large surfaces.

rules.name: The Flat Deck Rule
rules.body: Static panels use tonal layering and hairlines, not soft shadows.

dos: Do show connection, execution and failure states before secondary metadata.
Do preserve the same component vocabulary across every route.
Do adapt the information order for mobile rather than hiding critical actions.
donts: Don't use purple-blue gradients, glassmorphism, or decorative glow outside running-avatar status halos.
Don't wrap every item in the same rounded card.
Don't rely on color alone for status.
Don't use side-stripe borders or gradient text.
